title: L. The Camel Is Not Camelling

legend: While wandering through the desert, Ammar and his camel discover a sealed cave. A short chant opens the door, but there is still no water inside. Instead, Ammar finds the Bassami Water Puzzle.
The puzzle has an ordered box $$$v$$$. The box starts empty and can hold at most $$$m$$$ stones. Ammar then receives $$$n$$$ stones one by one.
The $$$i$$$-th stone is described by two values, $$$id_i$$$ and $$$state_i$$$:
$$$id_i$$$ is the identifier written on the stone;
$$$state_i=0$$$ means the stone is broken;
$$$state_i=1$$$ means the stone is unbroken.
The same identifier may appear more than once in the input. The box, however, never contains two stones with the same identifier.
For each incoming stone, apply the first rule below that matches the current box:
A stone with identifier $$$id_i$$$ is already in the box: remove that old stone from its current position, then put the incoming stone at the back of the box.
The box has fewer than $$$m$$$ stones: put the incoming stone at the back.
The box is full and contains at least one broken stone: remove the first broken stone, then put the incoming stone at the back.
The box is full, all stones in it are unbroken, and $$$state_i=1$$$: remove the first stone, then put the incoming stone at the back.
The box is full, all stones in it are unbroken, and $$$state_i=0$$$: ignore the incoming stone.
The first stone is the one closest to the front of the box. The back is the opposite end.
There are also $$$k$$$ curse moments. Immediately after processing the $$$c_j$$$-th stone for every $$$j$$$, the curse reverses the whole current order of the box.
After all stones and curses are handled, output the final contents of the box from front to back.
input: The first line contains one integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$) — the number of test cases.

Each test case starts with a line containing three integers $$$n$$$, $$$m$$$, and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n,m \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$, $$$0 \le k \le n$$$) — the number of processed stones, the capacity of the box, and the number of curse moments.
Each of the next $$$n$$$ lines contains two integers $$$id_i$$$ and $$$state_i$$$ ($$$1 \le id_i \le 10^9$$$, $$$state_i \in \{0,1\}$$$) — the identifier and state of the $$$i$$$-th stone.

After the stones, for $$$k \gt 0$$$, one more line contains $$$k$$$ distinct integers $$$c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_k$$$ ($$$1 \le c_1  \lt  c_2  \lt  \ldots  \lt  c_k \le n$$$). These are the processing steps followed by a curse. For $$$k=0$$$, this line is not present.
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, print two lines.
The first line contains one integer — the final number of stones in the box.
The second line contains the identifiers of the stones in the box from front to back, separated by spaces. For an empty box, print an empty second line.
note: In the first sample test case, the first three stones make the box $$$[1,2,3]$$$. The first curse reverses it to $$$[3,2,1]$$$.

Stone $$$4$$$ removes the first broken stone, so the box becomes $$$[2,1,4]$$$. Stone $$$5$$$ is unbroken; the full box has no broken stones, so the first stone is removed and the box becomes $$$[1,4,5]$$$. The second curse reverses it to $$$[5,4,1]$$$. Stone $$$6$$$ is broken, while the full box contains only unbroken stones, so stone $$$6$$$ is ignored.

legend: 在沙漠中游荡时，阿马尔和他的骆驼发现了一个封闭的洞穴。一声简短的呼喊打开了门，但里面仍然没有水。相反，Ammar找到了Bassami水拼图。
这个谜题有一个有序的盒子 $$$v$$$。盒子一开始是空的，最多只能容纳 $$$m$$$ 块石头。然后，阿马尔会一块一块地接收 $$$n$$$ 块石头。
第$$$i$$$块石头由$$$id_i$$$和$$$state_i$$$两个值描述：
$$$id_i$$$是写在石头上的标识符；
$$$state_i=0$$$ 意味着石头碎了;
$$$state_i=1$$$ 意味着这块石头完好无损。
同一个标识符可以在输入中出现多次。然而，盒子里从来没有两个具有相同标识符的石头。
对于每个进入的石头，应用以下第一个与当前盒子匹配的规则：
一个标识符为$$$id_i$$$的石头已经在盒子里了：把那个旧的石头从它当前的位置移开，然后把新石头放在盒子的后面。
盒子里的石头少于 $$$m$$$:将进来的石头放在盒子后面。
箱子是满的，里面至少有一块碎石头：把第一块碎石头移走，然后把后面来的石头放进去。
盒子已经满了，里面的所有石头都完好无损。$$$state_i=1$$$:取出第一块石头，然后将即将到来的石头放在后面。
箱子是满的，里面的石头都没有碎，$$$state_i=0$$$：忽略进来的石头。
第一块石头是离盒子正面最近的。背面是盒子的另一端。
处理完所有石头和诅咒后，从前到后输出盒子的最终内容。
input: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$t$$$($$$1 \le t \le 10^4$$$)——测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例都以包含三个整数$$$n$$$、$$$m$$$和$$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n,m \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$、$$$0 \le k \le n$$$）的一行开始——处理过的石头的数量、盒子的容量和诅咒时刻的数量。
接下来的 $$$n$$$ 行中的每一行都包含两个整数 $$$id_i$$$ 和 $$$state_i$$$($$$1 \le id_i \le 10^9$$$、$$$state_i \in \{0,1\}$$$)——即 $$$i$$$ 第三块石头的标识符和状态。
在石头之后，对于$$$k \gt 0$$$，再多一行包含$$$k$$$个不同的整数$$$c_1,c_2,\ldots,c_k$$$ ($$$1 \le c_1  \lt  c_2  \lt  \ldots  \lt  c_k \le n$$$）。这些是处理步骤之后的诅咒。对于$$$k=0$$$，这一行不存在。
保证所有测试用例的 $$$n$$$ 之和不超过 $$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。
output: 对于每个测试用例，打印两行。
第一行包含一个整数——盒子中的最终棋子数。
第二行包含盒子中石头的标识符，由空格分隔。对于空框，打印空的第二行。
note: 石头 $$$4$$$ 移除了第一块破碎的石头，因此盒子变成 $$$[2,1,4]$$$。石头 $$$5$$$ 未破碎;整个盒子没有破碎的石头，因此第一块石头被移除，盒子变成 $$$[1,4,5]$$$。第二个诅咒将其逆转为 $$$[5,4,1]$$$。石头 $$$6$$$ 破碎，而整个盒子只包含未破碎的石头，因此石头 $$$6$$$ 被忽略。
